blocked_sentences: Evoke—Exile a green card from your hand.
When this creature enters, up to one target player puts all the cards from their graveyard on the bottom of their library in a random order.

needs.what: an evoke cost that is a non-mana Cost -- 'Evoke--Exile a green card from your hand' (the MH3/MH2 pitch Incarnations: Endurance, Solitude, Grief, Fury, Subtlety) -- offered from hand as an alternative to the printed cost and setting the same cast-evoked flag that the card's 'when it enters, if evoked, sacrifice it' rule reads (702.74a supplies that sacrifice).
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `evoke` is parsed as a ManaCost only (loader `ManaCost.parse(model.evoke)`, carddef `evoke: ManaCost | None`). `alternative_cost` takes a full Cost with `exile_from_hand: {colors: [G]}` (as Force of Will / Pyrokinesis do), but per its schema note it deliberately does not report `cast_evoked`, so the evoke sacrifice cannot be keyed off it, and the loader refuses an 'evoked' condition on a card without an `evoke` cost.

needs.what: a `random_order` option on `put_on_top` (with `bottom: true`) that places the moved cards on the bottom of the library in a random order, for 'puts all the cards from their graveyard on the bottom of their library in a random order' (Endurance, also Tormod's Crypt-style tucks, cascade/discover leftovers).
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `put_on_top` (ops_cards.py) offers `bottom` and `any_order` (owner chooses order) or pool order; neither is random, and a `shuffle` op afterwards would randomise the whole library, not just the bottom segment.
